items.question: What is PostgreSQL?
answer_points: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development.
It is ACID-compliant and runs on all major operating systems.
It has a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance.
It supports advanced features like JSON/JSONB, full-text search, and extensibility.

items.source_title: PostgreSQL: The world's most advanced open source database

items.question: What are the key features of PostgreSQL?
answer_points: PostgreSQL is ACID-compliant and supports complex queries with sophisticated optimizer.
It offers a wide range of data types including primitives, structured, document, geometry.
It ensures data integrity through UNIQUE, NOT NULL, primary/foreign keys, exclusion constraints, and explicit/advisory locks.
It handles concurrency via Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) and parallelization of queries and index building.
It provides reliability through Write-ahead Logging (WAL), replication, and point-in-time recovery.
It is extensible with custom functions, procedural languages, foreign data wrappers, and many extensions like PostGIS.

items.summary: PostgreSQL is a feature-rich open-source database with strong ACID compliance, extensibility, and advanced indexing.

items.question: How to download and install PostgreSQL?
answer_points: PostgreSQL is available as ready-to-use packages or installers for Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD, and Solaris.
Source code is also available for building from scratch.
Beta/RC releases and development snapshots are available for testing only, not for production.
Additional software and extensions can be found in the Software Catalogue.

items.question: PostgreSQL 19 Beta 1 发布了哪些重要新特性？
answer_points: 异步 I/O 子系统改进，io_method=worker 自动调整 I/O 工作者数量
新增 pg_plan_advice 和 pg_stash_advice 扩展以稳定查询计划
自动清理支持并行，新增 autovacuum_max_parallel_workers 和评分系统
支持 SQL/PGQ 属性图查询，扩展时序查询（FOR PORTION OF）
新增 ALTER TABLE MERGE/SPLIT PARTITIONS、GROUP BY ALL 语法
逻辑复制支持序列值复制，无需重启即可启用逻辑复制
